summary: coding completed item-model-and-storage; 14 incomplete feature(s) remain
commands: ls -la && echo "---API---" && ls -R api 2>/dev/null | head -60 && echo "---podex.ps1---" && ls *.ps1 *.psd1 *.json 2>/dev/null

ls -la tests/ && echo "---pwsh---" && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); (Get-Module -ListAvailable PSSQLite | Select-Object -First 1).Version.ToString()' 2>&1 | head -20

cat > /tmp/pantry-verify.ps1 <<'EOF'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module -Name 'PSSQLite' -MaximumVersion 1.99.99 -Force
. "$PSScriptRoot/api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1"

$db = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("pantry-verify-{0}.db" -f ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')))
if (Test-Path $db) { Remove-Item $db -Force }

$fail = 0
function Check($cond, $msg) {
	if ($cond) { Write-Host "PASS: $msg" }
	else { Write-Host "FAIL: $msg"; $script:fail++ }
}

Initialize-PantryStore -DataSource $db
Check ($true) "Initialize-PantryStore ran"

# --- create + round-trip ---
$a = New-PantryItem -DataSource $db -Name 'Olive oil' -Category 'Oils' -Quantity 2 -Unit 'bottles' -Expiry '2026-09-01' -Threshold 1 -Notes 'extra virgin'
Check ($a.id -gt 0) "create returns positive id ($($a.id))"
Check ($a.name -eq 'Olive oil') "round-trip name"
Check ($a.category -eq 'Oils') "round-trip category"
Check ([double]$a.quantity -eq 2) "round-trip quantity"
Check ($a.unit -eq 'bottles') "round-trip unit"
Check ($a.expiry -eq '2026-09-01') "round-trip expiry"
Check ([double]$a.threshold -eq 1) "round-trip threshold"
Check ($a.notes -eq 'extra virgin') "round-trip notes"
Check (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($a.created_at)) "created_at populated ($($a.created_at))"
Check (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($a.updated_at)) "updated_at populated"

# optional fields omitted -> stored NULL
$b = New-PantryItem -DataSource $db -Name 'Rice' -Category 'Grains' -Quantity 5 -Unit 'kg'
Check ($null -eq $b.expiry -or $b.expiry -is [System.DBNull]) "omitted expiry is NULL"
Check ($null -eq $b.notes -or $b.notes -is [System.DBNull]) "omitted notes is NULL"
Check ([double]$b.threshold -eq 1) "threshold defaults to 1"

# --- unique + stable ids ---
Check ($a.id -ne $b.id) "ids unique across items"
$aRead = Get-PantryItem -DataSource $db -Id $a.id
Check ($aRead.id -eq $a.id -and $aRead.name -eq 'Olive oil') "read by id returns stable record"

# --- list ---
$list = Get-PantryItems -DataSource $db
Check ($list.Count -eq 2) "list returns all items ($($list.Count))"
Check ($list[0].name -eq 'Olive oil' -and $list[1].name -eq 'Rice') "list sorted by name asc"

# --- update ---
$u = Update-PantryItem -DataSource $db -Id $a.id -Name 'Olive oil' -Category 'Oils' -Quantity 1 -Unit 'bottles' -Expiry '2026-10-01' -Threshold 2 -Notes 'half used'
Check ([double]$u.quantity -eq 1) "update changes quantity"
Check ($u.expiry -eq '2026-10-01') "update changes expiry"
Check ([double]$u.threshold -eq 2) "update changes threshold"
Check ($u.id -eq $a.id) "update keeps id stable"

# --- delete ---
Remove-PantryItem -DataSource $db -Id $b.id
$afterDel = Get-PantryItems -DataSource $db
Check ($afterDel.Count -eq 1 -and $afterDel[0].id -eq $a.id) "delete removes only target item"

# report db path so the restart check (separate process) can reopen it
Write-Host "DBPATH=$db"
Write-Host "FAILCOUNT=$fail"
if ($fail -gt 0) { exit 1 }
EOF
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File /tmp/pantry-verify.ps1 2>&1

DB="$(cygpath -m "$(mktemp -u)").pantry-restart.db"
cat > /tmp/pantry-write.ps1 <<'EOF'
param([string]$Db)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module -Name 'PSSQLite' -MaximumVersion 1.99.99 -Force
. "D:/applications/pantry/api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1"
Initialize-PantryStore -DataSource $Db
$x = New-PantryItem -DataSource $Db -Name 'Canned beans' -Category 'Canned' -Quantity 4 -Unit 'cans' -Threshold 2
Write-Host "WROTE id=$($x.id) to $Db"
EOF
cat > /tmp/pantry-read.ps1 <<'EOF'
param([string]$Db)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module -Name 'PSSQLite' -MaximumVersion 1.99.99 -Force
. "D:/applications/pantry/api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1"
$items = Get-PantryItems -DataSource $Db
if ($items.Count -eq 1 -and $items[0].name -eq 'Canned beans' -and [double]$items[0].quantity -eq 4) {
	Write-Host "PASS: data durable across process restart (id=$($items[0].id), name=$($items[0].name))"
} else {
	Write-Host "FAIL: expected persisted 'Canned beans', got $($items | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)"; exit 1
}
EOF
echo "=== process 1 (write) ==="
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File /tmp/pantry-write.ps1 -Db "$DB" 2>&1
echo "=== process 2 (fresh process, read) ==="
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File /tmp/pantry-read.ps1 -Db "$DB" 2>&1
rm -f "$DB" /tmp/pantry-write.ps1 /tmp/pantry-read.ps1 /tmp/pantry-verify.ps1

cd <WORKSPACE>/pantry
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '
Import-Module PSScriptAnalyzer
Write-Host "=== baseline: podex.ps1 + api/crud ==="
$r = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path ./podex.ps1,./api/crud -Severity Warning,Error
if ($r) { $r | Group-Object RuleName | Select-Object Count,Name | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host } else { Write-Host "clean" }
' 2>&1
echo "=== non-ASCII bytes in pantry-store.ps1 ==="
grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1 || echo "(none found)"

cd <WORKSPACE>/pantry
pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '
Import-Module PSScriptAnalyzer
Write-Host "=== baseline podex.ps1 ==="
$b = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path ./podex.ps1 -Severity Warning,Error
if ($b) { $b | Group-Object RuleName | Select-Object Count,Name | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host } else { Write-Host "clean" }
Write-Host "=== baseline api/crud ==="
$c = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path ./api/crud -Recurse -Severity Warning,Error
if ($c) { $c | Group-Object RuleName | Select-Object Count,Name | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host } else { Write-Host "clean" }
Write-Host "=== pantry-store.ps1 after em-dash fix ==="
$m = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path ./api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1 -Severity Warning,Error
if ($m) { $m | Select-Object RuleName,Line,Message | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap | Out-String | Write-Host } else { Write-Host "clean" }
' 2>&1

cd <WORKSPACE>/pantry
echo "=== eslint ==="
npx eslint . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "eslint exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "=== prettier check (plugin-free temp config) on edited json/md ==="
cat > .prettier.tmp.mjs <<'EOF'
const config = { trailingComma: 'es5', tabWidth: 4, semi: true, singleQuote: true, printWidth: 180, useTabs: true, bracketSameLine: true };
export default config;
EOF
npx prettier --config .prettier.tmp.mjs --check ".aidd/features/item-model-and-storage/feature.json" ".aidd/CHANGELOG.md" 2>&1; echo "prettier exit: $?"
rm -f .prettier.tmp.mjs

cd <WORKSPACE>/pantry
echo "=== my feature.json indent (cat -A, first 5 lines) ==="
sed -n '1,5p' .aidd/features/item-model-and-storage/feature.json | cat -A
echo "=== sibling untouched feature.json indent ==="
sed -n '1,5p' .aidd/features/item-crud/feature.json | cat -A

cd <WORKSPACE>/pantry
git add podex.ps1 api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1 .aidd/features/item-model-and-storage/feature.json .aidd/CHANGELOG.md
echo "=== staged files ==="
git diff --staged --name-only

cd <WORKSPACE>/pantry
git commit -m "feat(storage): add pantry Item model and data-access layer" \
  -m "- New api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1: SQLite-backed DAL (Initialize/New/Get/Get-list/Update/Remove) with parameterized SQL and one-place datasource resolution" \
  -m "- podex.ps1: dot-source the DAL, skip api/_lib in route discovery, run Initialize-PantryStore at boot" \
  -m "- Verified headless (pwsh 7.6.3 + PSSQLite 1.1.0): 23 assertions incl. CRUD/list, unique stable ids, full round-trip, NULL optionals; separate-process write/read proves restart durability" \
  -m "- Marked item-model-and-storage passes:true / status:completed" 2>&1 | tail -8
echo "=== post-commit status ==="
git status --short
